title: Leading UV Formula for Finite-Volume Vertex Operator Expectation Values in the Sine-Gordon Model from Kink NLIE
summary: We study the ultraviolet (UV) limit of finite-volume expectation values of vertex operators in the sine-Gordon model using the kink nonlinear integral equation (NLIE) description of the conformal limit. By analysing the integrable formulation of vacuum expectation values in the small-volume regime, we conjecture an explicit analytic expression for the leading asymptotic term in the small-volume expansion, formulated in terms of kink functions.
